chunks: And my father (may Allah have mercy on him) and a group of my scholars narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from 'Ali ibn Isma'il, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Rib'i, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:

Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: What is wrong with you? Why do you not go to him? – This refers to the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him). Verily, four thousand angels cry next to him until the Day of Judgment.
ai.seo_question: Why should Muslims visit the grave of Imam Husayn (a.s.)?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) emphasizes the spiritual gravity of visiting the shrine of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) by noting that four thousand angels weep beside it until the Day of Judgment. This highlights the site as a locus of divine presence and eternal mourning, reinforcing the Shia practice of *ziyarat* as a means of connecting with the celestial realm and the Ahl al-Bayt's enduring sacrifice.
